Rashi on Ketubot 31a:1:1.hebrew: וקרע שיראים - בשעה שבולעה, ואע"ג דמיתה לאו משום ממונא דניזק אתיא ליה, מיפטר. וסבירא ליה לרב אשי: מיתה לזה ותשלומין לזה — פטור:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:1:1.english: And he tore silk - At the moment he swallows it; and even though the death penalty does not come upon him on account of the injured party's property, he is exempt. And Rav Ashi holds: [where] death [is incurred] to this [party] and payment to that [party], he is exempt.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:2:1.hebrew: שעקירה צורך הנחה היא - הלכך, אע"ג דחיוב ממון מקמי הנחה אתיא ליה, פטור, הואיל ובין עקירה והנחה אתיא ליה. מיתה ותשלומין באין כאחד, שעקירה צורך הנחה היא, ומההיא שעתא אתחלה לה מלאכה:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:2:1.english: For lifting is a prerequisite for placement - Therefore, even though the monetary liability comes upon him before placement, [he is] exempt, since it comes upon him between lifting and placement. Death and payment come simultaneously, for lifting is a prerequisite for placement, and from that moment the [prohibited] labor has begun.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:3:1.hebrew: דאי בעי גחין - למטה מג' טפחים ואכיל, ובציר מג' לאו הגבהה היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:3:1.english: For if he wishes, he bends down - below three handbreadths and eats, and less than three [handbreadths] is not [considered] lifting.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:3:2.hebrew: לא מצי לאהדורה - משזרק את החץ. הלכך, משעת עקירה סופו לקרוע לו שיראין:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:3:2.english: He cannot bring it back - Once he has shot the arrow. Therefore, from the moment of lifting [it], its end [result] is to tear silk [garments] for him.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:3:3.hebrew: הכא מצי מהדר ליה - הלכך, לא אמרי' משעת הגבהה אתחלה לה אכילה:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:3:3.english: Here, he could replace it - Therefore, we do not say [that] from the time of lifting, eating began.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:4:1.english: One who carries a knife - In his hand while walking.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:1.hebrew: הגונב כיס בשבת - הגביהו ברשות הבעלים והוציאו לרה"ר:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:1.english: One who steals a purse on Shabbat - He lifted it in the owner's domain and carried it out into the public domain.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:2.english: [He is] liable - for payment, even though he is executed.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:3.hebrew: שכבר נתחייב בגניבה - לשלם, דהגבהה קונה בכל מקום, וקמה לה ברשותיה אף להתחייב באונסים:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:3.english: Because he was already liable for theft - To pay, for lifting acquires everywhere, and it stands in his possession even to become liable for unavoidable accidents.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:4.hebrew: היה מגרר ויוצא - שלא הגביהו ברשות הבעלים ולא קנאו אלא בהוצאה מרשות הבעלים, פטור, שאיסור שבת כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:5:4.english: He was dragging [it] and exiting - Since he did not lift it in the owner's domain and did not acquire it except by taking [it] out of the owner's domain, [he is] exempt, for the prohibition of Shabbat, etc.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:6:1.hebrew: ואמאי - כי הגביהו ברשות הבעלים וקנאו, אמאי חייב? נימא משעת הגבהה אתחלה לה הוצאה:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:6:1.english: But why - When he lifted it in the owner's domain and acquired it, why is he liable [to pay]? Let us say [that] from the moment of lifting, the carrying out began.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:7:1.hebrew: וכה"ג מי חייב - משום שבת:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:7:1.english: And in a case like that, is he liable - On account of Shabbat.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:7:2.english: For that - To carry it out.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:8:1.hebrew: לא תימא בהגביהו ע"מ להצניעו אלא הגביהו ע"מ להוציאו - ודקשיא לך, נימא הגבהה צורך הוצאה היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:8:1.english: Do not say [when] he lifted it in order to conceal it; rather, he lifted it in order to carry it out - And as for that which is difficult for you, [that] we should say lifting is a requirement for carrying out:

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:8:2.hebrew: הכא במאי עסקינן כשעמד - ועמידתו היא הנחה לעקירה ראשונה, ואין חיוב שבת באה לו ע"י עקירת חפץ הראשונה, אלא ע"י עקירת גופו, שעוקר עצמו אחר העמידה על מנת להוציא. ועקירת גופו כעקירת חפץ:
Rashi on Ketubot 31a:8:2.english: With what [case] are we dealing here? Where he stopped - And his stopping is a placing down for the first lifting, and the Shabbat liability does not come to him through the first lifting of the object, but rather through the moving of his body, in that he moves himself after stopping in order to carry [it] out; and the moving of his body is like the lifting of an object.

Rashi on Ketubot 31a:9:1.english: It is his way - and his stopping is not [considered] a placing down to nullify the first lifting from [constituting] a Sabbath labor.

Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:2:1.hebrew: שעקירה צורך הנחה היא - קשה, דאמרינן במרובה (ב"ק דף ע:) גבי גנב ומכר בשבת דפטור, כגון דאמר ליה: זרוק גניבותיך לחצרי ותיקני לי חצירי גניבותיך; ופריך: מכי מטי לאויר חצירו קנה, ומתחייב בנפשו משום שבת לא הוי עד שתנוח! ומאי פריך? והא עקירה צורך הנחה היא, כדאמר הכא! ולפר"ת אתי שפיר, דפירש דאי אפשר לניסוך בלא הגבהה, ואפ"ה קאמר רב מנסך ממש בהניזקין (גיטין דף נב: ושם) ולא קא מפטר משום דקים ליה בדרבה מיניה, כדרבי ירמיה, דמשעת הגבהה קונה ומתחייב בנפשו לא הוי עד שעת ניסוך. והשתא רבי ירמיה לית ליה דהגבהה צורך ניסוך היא, וה"ה דלית ליה דעקירה צורך הנחה היא, ולא הוה מפליג בין מצי לאהדורי ללא מצי לאהדורי. תדע, ללישנא דאי אפשר להנחה בלא עקירה, אמאי נקט רבי אבין זרק חץ? לינקוט מעביר! אלא ודאי כי הדדי נינהו, ומאן דפליג אמעביר פליג נמי אזורק. ואליבא דרבי ירמיה פריך במרובה (ב"ק דף ע: ושם), אבל אם אפשר לניסוך בלא הגבהה — לא פליג רבי ירמיה אדרבי אבין. ובהגוזל בתרא (שם דף קיז.) משמע קצת דרבי ירמיה פליג אדרבי אבין, גבי חזרו לומר אף המנסך, דקאמר התם: מעיקרא סבור כדרבי אבין, ולבסוף סבור כדרבי ירמיה. [ומיהו יש לדחות דמעיקרא סבור דדמיא לדרבי אבין, ולבסוף סבור דדמיא לדר' ירמיה]:
Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:2:1.english: "As lifting is a prerequisite for placement" - [This] is difficult, for we say in [the chapter entitled] Merubeh (Bava Kamma 70b), regarding one who steals and sells [an animal] on Shabbat, that he is exempt [from the fourfold or fivefold payment], such as when [the buyer] said to him, "Throw your stolen [animal] into my courtyard, and let my courtyard acquire your stolen [animal] for me"; and [the Gemara] asks: From the moment it reaches the airspace of his courtyard he has acquired [it], whereas he does not become liable for his life on account of Shabbat until it comes to rest! But what is [the Gemara] asking? Surely lifting is a prerequisite for placement, as it says here! According to the explanation of Rabbeinu Tam, this works out well, for he explained that [even] where libation is impossible without lifting, even so Rav says [it refers to] one who actually pours a libation in [the chapter entitled] Hanizakin (Gittin 52b and there), and he is not exempt on account of [the principle that] he is subject to the greater [punishment], in accordance with Rabbi Yirmiyah — that from the moment of lifting he acquires [liability for the wine], whereas he does not become liable for his life until the time of the libation. Now, Rabbi Yirmiyah does not hold that lifting is a prerequisite for libation, and by the same token he does not hold that lifting is a prerequisite for placement, and he would not distinguish between [a case where] he can return [it] and [a case where] he cannot return [it]. Know [that this is so]: according to the version [that the reason is] that placement is impossible without lifting, why did Rabbi Avin specify one who throws an arrow? Let him specify one who carries [an object]! Rather, they are certainly alike, and whoever disagrees regarding one who carries disagrees also regarding one who throws. And it is according to Rabbi Yirmiyah that [the Gemara] asks in Merubeh (Bava Kamma 70b and there); however, if libation is possible without lifting, Rabbi Yirmiyah does not disagree with Rabbi Avin. And in Hagozeil Batra (there, 117a) it is somewhat implied that Rabbi Yirmiyah disagrees with Rabbi Avin, regarding [the statement] "they retracted to say: even one who pours a libation," where it says there: originally they held like Rabbi Avin, and in the end they held like Rabbi Yirmiyah. [However, one can reject this proof, saying that originally they held that it is comparable to Rabbi Avin's case, and in the end they held that it is comparable to Rabbi Yirmiyah's case.]

Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:3:1.hebrew: דאי בעי גחין ואכיל - פי' בקונט': למטה מג', דלא הויא הגבהה. וקשה לר"י: דמה שייך הגבהה בדבר שהוא תופס בידו או בפיו? ד"ונתן בידה" אמר רחמנא, ואמרינן בגיטין (דף עח.): זרק לתוך קלתה — מגורשת, קשורה אע"פ שאינה תלויה, אע"ג דמיירי ברשות הבעל; ואפי' מאן דבעי התם תלויה, אינו מצריך שתהא גבוה ג'. אלא נראה לר"י דה"פ ד"אי בעי גחין ואכיל": אם הוא בראש קנה, יכול הוא לשחות ולתוחבה עד בית בליעתו. אע"ג דבהך אכילה אינו עושה כן והויא הגבהה זו לצורך אכילה, מ"מ הואיל ויכול להתחייב בלא הגבהה — לאו צורך אכילה היא. וה"ה דה"מ למימר דאפשר לאכילה בלא הגבהה, כגון אם תחבה לו חבירו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:3:1.english: For if he wishes, he bends down and eats - Rashi explained: [he eats] below three [handbreadths], for [an elevation of less than three handbreadths] is not considered lifting. And this is difficult for the Ri: What relevance does lifting [three handbreadths] have to something that he is holding in his hand or in his mouth? For the Merciful One said, "and he shall place it in her hand" [Deuteronomy 24:1], and we say in Gittin (78a) [that if] he threw [a bill of divorce] into her basket, she is divorced, [and if it is] tied [to her], even though it is not suspended [in the air, she is divorced], even though [the case] is dealing with the husband's domain; and even the one who requires there [that the basket be] suspended does not require that it be three [handbreadths] high. Rather, it appears to the Ri that this is the explanation of "for if he wishes, he bends down and eats": if [the fat] is at the top of a reed, he can bend down and thrust it into his throat. Even though in this [actual] eating he does not do so, and this lifting is for the purpose of eating, nevertheless, since he can become liable without lifting, it is not [considered] a necessity of eating. And the same applies [that the Gemara] could have said that eating is possible without lifting, for example, if his fellow thrust it into his [mouth].

Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:6:1.hebrew: הכא נמי נימא הגבהה צורך הוצאה היא - ללישנא דאי בעי לאהדורי לא מצי מיהדר א], לא פריך מידי; אבל ללישנא דאי אפשר להנחה בלא עקירה, פריך, דהכא נמי אי אפשר להנחה בלא הגבהה. אע"ג דאפשר בגרירה, כך לי עקירה זו כמו עקירה אחרת, דמ"מ האיסור מתחיל משעת הגבהה — דאם היה אחר עושה עקירה, לא היה מתחייב בהנחה; נמצא עקירה גורמת החיוב, ועד שעת הנחה מושך החיוב:
Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:6:1.english: Here, too, let us say that lifting is a prerequisite for carrying out - According to the version [that the reason for exemption is that] if he wanted to return it, he could not return it, [the Gemara] raises no difficulty at all; but according to the version [that the reason is that] placing down is impossible without uprooting, it raises a difficulty, for here too placing down is impossible without lifting. Even though [carrying out] is possible by dragging, this uprooting [by lifting] is the same to me as another uprooting [by dragging], for in any case the prohibition begins from the time of lifting — since if another person had performed the uprooting, he would not be liable upon placing [it] down; thus, the uprooting causes the liability, and the liability extends until the time of placing [it] down.

Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:6:2.hebrew: נימא הגבהה צורך הוצאה היא - תימה לפר"ת, דהגבהה קונה פחות משלשה טפחים: מאי פריך? והא כיון דקנאה קודם התחלת העקירה — דעקירה לא הויא עד שיגביה שלשה, דלמטה משלשה הוי כלבוד, כדאמרינן בהמוציא (שבת דף פ. ושם): "העביר חצי גרוגרת דרך עליה — חייב" — ואם כן, דין הוא שיתחייב, כמו לבן עזאי דאמר "מהלך כעומד דמי" דחייב, לפי שקנאה קודם שהתחיל העקירה. ואומר רשב"א, דמשמע ליה בכל ענין "גונב כיס", אפילו מונח על גבי מקל שהוא גבוה שלשה טפחים, שבא הקנין והעקירה בבת אחת:
Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:6:2.english: "Let us say that lifting is a prerequisite for carrying out" - This is astonishing according to the explanation of Rabbeinu Tam, [who holds] that lifting acquires [even] less than three handbreadths [above the ground]: what does [the Gemara] ask? For since he acquired it before the beginning of the uprooting — as uprooting does not occur until he lifts [it] three [handbreadths], for below three [handbreadths] it is considered like lavud [attached to the ground], as we say in [the chapter] HaMotzi (Shabbat 80a and there): "[If] he passed half a dried fig over it, he is liable" — if so, it stands to reason that he should be liable, just like according to Ben Azzai, who says "walking is considered like standing," where he is liable because he acquired it before he began the uprooting. And Rashba says that "one who steals a purse" implies to [the Gemara] in any case, even [when] it is resting on top of a stick that is three handbreadths high, where the acquisition and the uprooting come simultaneously.

Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:6:3.hebrew: שהגביהו על מנת להצניעו ונמלך להוציאו - ואם תאמר: וכיון דסלקא דעתיה השתא דמיחייב אהך הוצאה, אם כן הדרא קושיא לדוכתין, דצורך הוצאה היא! ויש לומר דסלקא דעתין: הא דנמלך והוציאו הוי עקירה שניה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:6:3.english: "Where he lifted it in order to conceal it and reconsidered to carry it out" - And if you will say: Since it is now assumed that he is liable [for Shabbat] on this carrying out, if so, the question returns to its place, that [the initial lifting] is a prerequisite for carrying out! And one can say that we assume [that] this [act] where he reconsidered and carried it out is a second uprooting [akirah].

Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:9:1.hebrew: אבל לכתף מאי פטור כו' - אפילו הוי לכתף חייב, הוי מצי למיפרך דליפלוג בדידיה בין עמד ללא עמד כלל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 31a:9:1.english: But [if he stopped] to adjust [the burden on his] shoulder, what [is the law]? He is exempt, etc. - Even if [stopping] to adjust [on his] shoulder were liable, [the Gemara] could have asked that [the tanna] should distinguish within [that case] itself between [where] he stopped and [where] he did not stop at all.
